rootInstructions: Read docs/progress/status.md, docs/progress/timeline.md, and the latest docs/progress/logs/YYYY-MM-DD.md.
Read spec/rolemux-development-spec.md before major feature work.
Read docs/dev/code-style.md before changing TypeScript, Skill, role prompt, or test files.
Do not read, print, or store secrets, tokens, cookies, or private credentials.
Do not use dangerous bypass or sandbox flags unless the user explicitly requests them.
Update progress trace documents for every delivered change.
Verification evidence is required before claiming completion.

agents.name: rolemux-researcher
agents.purpose: Research specs, prior decisions, CLI/provider references, and affected files.
defaultValidation: Summarize exact files read and findings.
Report gaps, risks, and suggested next checks.

agents.name: rolemux-architect
agents.purpose: Design CLI boundaries, module interfaces, task artifact schema, and safe defaults.
defaultValidation: Check plans for scope, contradictions, missing validation, and unclear ownership.

agents.name: rolemux-cli-builder
agents.purpose: Implement CLI commands, core services, provider adapters, and tests.

agents.name: rolemux-skill-builder
agents.purpose: Implement Codex/Claude Skills, default role prompts, and install copy behavior.
defaultValidation: Check Skill trigger text and install paths.

agents.name: rolemux-reviewer
agents.purpose: Review correctness, security boundaries, cross-platform path behavior, and test gaps.
defaultValidation: Report findings with severity and file references.
Do not modify files unless explicitly authorized.

agents.name: rolemux-docs-keeper
agents.purpose: Maintain progress records, README, specs, development docs, and validation notes.
defaultValidation: Check links and referenced paths are current.
